bricks.label: Anker 747 Charger (GaNPrime 150W)
bricks.port_distribution_note: One USB-C port alone can provide 100W. Two USB-C ports together share a 150W maximum; no fixed per-port split is published - allocation is dynamic (PowerIQ 4.0).

combos.measured: 71.6W + 67.6W with two 16-inch MacBooks attached; characterized as a 75W+75W rule

multiport_allocation.priority_rule: Dynamic Power Distribution (PowerIQ 4.0): no fixed C+C split. A high-draw primary can leave the secondary port well under 50W - user-measured ~25W to the Y270 while a MacBook charged on the first port.

measured_combos.c1_usb_a: 88.56W + 20.59W (100W+24W rule; exceeded the 24W C1+A label cap via dynamic allocation)

multiport_allocation.cascade_detail: Re-advertised PDOs on a new port are capped at (budget - existing draw). A port already charging can see its granted current cut without a new PD message: measured 20V/3.25A (~65W) -> 20V/2.2A (~44W) immediately when another device attached (PD-packet capture). Anker documents redistribution roughly every 3 minutes, releasing extra power to other ports. So a ~25W second-port reading is a transient/priority state, not a hard cap - when both devices renegotiate, the ceiling is much higher (75W+75W observed).

ports.label: USB-C 1
ports.pps_note: Metered PPS 3.3-11V/5A on all three USB-C ports (chongdiantou POWER-Z KM002C, ChargerLab KM003C). Satisfies Samsung SFC 25W (needs >=2.75A in 3.3-11V) and the 5A threshold for SFC 2.0 45W via the 10V/4.5A path.

measured.efficiency: 87.3-94.4% across voltage taps at full load; no-load draw 0.221W

measured.macbook16_full_charge: 1h57m (45% @30min, 82% @60min), peak 90.6W - device taper, not charger derating

bricks.label: CUKTECH A12 65W GaN ultrathin card charger

ports.label: USB-C
ports.pps_note: No metered PPS test exists for the A12 itself. CUKTECH 65W-family card/2C1A bricks (AD652S, AD653C/EU) meter PPS 5-11V/5A; the international A12 is model AD651N, whose manual only states 'supports PD3.0 and PPS'. Value here is family inference (medium confidence). Covers Samsung SFC 25W (3.3-11V >=2.75A).

bricks.model_note: Owner calls this the 'A12 card charger'. The international A12 (AD651N) is a 50x50x28mm cube; CUKTECH's card-form charger is the China-market 6号电能卡片 (AD652S). If the owner's unit is the AD652S, the metered family PPS data applies directly. Confirm the model code on the unit.

measured.sustained_output: No dedicated sustained-load test for the A12; a sibling CUKTECH 65W brick (AD653CEU) held a metered 65W sustained
